max_body_size set to -1 is rejected as invalid config

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	pkg "github.com/xberg-io/crawlberg/packages/go"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	var engineConfig pkg.CrawlConfig
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"max_body_size":0}`), &engineConfig); err != nil {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("config parse failed: %v", err))
	}
	engine, createErr := pkg.CreateEngine(&engineConfig)
	if createErr != nil {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("create handle failed: %v", createErr))
	}
	url := `https://example.com`
	_, err := pkg.Scrape(engine, url)
	var typedError pkg.Error
	if errors.As(err, &typedError) {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%T: %v\n", typedError, typedError)
	}
}
```
